title: Amsterdam canal house
request: Create a house in Amsterdam style. Defaults chosen by the director (the person gave no further details): a single traditional Amsterdam canal house (grachtenpand), narrow and tall. About 6 m wide, 8 m deep, roughly 15 m tall to the gable top. Four storeys plus an attic. Dark brown-red brick facade with white-painted stone trim. A classic bell gable (klokgevel) with white sandstone scroll ornaments at the top, a white hoisting beam with a hook sticking out under the gable peak, and a slight forward lean of the facade is optional. Tall white-framed sash windows in a regular grid (3 per floor), with the windows getting slightly shorter on the upper floors. A raised front entrance with a short flight of stone steps (stoep) and black iron railings. A dark green or black painted front door with a transom window above. A small basement window beside the steps. Dark slate or tile roof behind the gable. Side walls plain brick, since it would normally stand between neighbours. No real brand names or text. Purpose: a realistic render. Use a realistic product-style studio render on a plain light background, at a front three-quarter view from street level, so the facade, the gable and some depth of the side wall all show. Make sure every fix shows up in the exported GLB, not only in the .blend file.

spec.summary: A narrow, tall four-storey-plus-attic Amsterdam canal house in dark brown-red brick with a white-trimmed classic bell gable topped with sandstone scrolls and a hoisting beam with hook. The raised front has a short stoep of stone steps flanked by black iron railings, a dark green door with transom, and three tall white sash windows per floor, shrinking slightly upward. Side walls are plain brick, as the house would stand between neighbours.
